interface.longDescription: An opinionated skill pack for taking software work from ambiguity to verified delivery. Includes 22 composable skills. Skills-only Marketplace Plugins support Claude Code and Codex. Pi and Hermes support direct skill loading. Skills cover clarification, execution, debugging, UI, review, QA, shipping, cross-model judgment, trust gates, writing, and skill construction.
